about: Every upstream file the fork edits by hand. seam names the section of STUDIO_FORK.md; intent says what the edit must keep doing after a conflict is resolved; budget is the most added plus removed lines the file may carry. Checked by scripts/fork/check-core-diff.mjs.

This file keeps the plugin field on an option, its key, a one-line select branch (selectPluginPaletteRow: Mod+Enter runs experimental_onModSelect, else navigate to the row's path), the empty-state check and the two section renders. The main-view split shortcut is gated by MAIN_SPLITS_ENABLED. Fork imports sit at the top of the file.

The Escape handler first returns when forkCommandPaletteEscape(event) is true (the replacement's experimental_onEscape handler claimed the key), then keeps the dialog open to leave search mode only when forkCommandPaletteActive() is false, so Escape otherwise closes a replacement.

apps/app/src/components/secondary-panel/.intent: One row of tabs, with every rule in workbenchFork.tsx: fixedPanelTabsFirst sorts fixed plugin tabs to the front, useFixedPanelTabDisplay turns off dragging for them, FixedPanelTabGroupEnd draws the divider after the last fixed tab, and PanelTabActionMenuItems is the one line that puts the fork's pane move and pop-out items first in a tab's context menu. Tabs shrink instead of scrolling early, and the active tab always shows its close button. Every non-fixed tab is a native drag source: usePanelTabNativeDrag returns the draggable/onDragStart/onDragEnd props spread on the tab's wrapper (after dnd-kit's listeners), and when it does, the wrapper's onPointerDown skips bb's pane drag (onBeginTabDrag); the mouse sensor is InertMouseSensor so the mouse never starts dnd-kit's sort, while touch keeps dnd-kit's sensor, the sort and PanelTabItemDragSource (one line inside the DndContext, sending the item payload to whatever is under the pointer outside the strip).

One hook line, useWorkbenchSplits, before the first early return, hands moveTab, removeSplit, resize and commitState to the menu items and the plugin API.

usePinnedFixedPanelTabs marks the fixed plugin tabs that apply to this panel as pinned, which is what removes their close button and keeps them out of Close other tabs and the mobile pager's close. WorkbenchPanelScope wraps the tab row so tab menu items know which panel they are in. PinnedIconTabsDivider follows bb's own icon tabs when no fixed plugin tab does. WORKBENCH_NEW_TAB_IN_EVERY_PANE gives every split pane its own New Tab button (one condition in each of the two new-tab lines of renderPane).
Uses the per-instance icon for plugin action tabs.
